Shatsky); approved NRS VSEGEI 16.12.1986; printed VSEGEI St Petersburg 1999; RASTER = geokniga 1804x2378 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px, labels barely legible); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py, legend-seeded); same-colour units merged; cover formations printed only as SYMBOLS over the base colour are detected as symbol regions (work/r200d/prep_overprint.py: peat bIV = green T marks; subaerial cover loams sa = red-brown dashes, told from the black loam-lithology dashes by their redness; glyph buffer ~0.8 x symbol spacing ~1 km; pieces of other outlined units without symbols removed) and carried as composites <cover>/<base> (hclass of the cover: peat O, subaerial cover loams E per PI decision 2026-10-04; hclass2 = base); region boundaries good to ~+-1 km; frame = 4 measured inner corners + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties (work/r200d/<sheet>/gratties.txt) ; pinned to the legend tint (map calibration drifted onto alluvium) ; same printed colour as dIII-IV: one class
